method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A face-on terracotta square on tiles with a typed label, a flat drawing with no subject, scale or light direction.
notes.fix: Model the cover's wafer boat on a raised caliche relief of Lubbock County, lit low from one side.

notes.problem: A stucco textured square in a grid of identical mid brown tiles under a hard seam, with black label type printed on the copper.
notes.fix: Lower the surrounding county tiles to near black, raise only the Lubbock tile with a strong side light, and let the vignette carry up into the headline area.

notes.problem: A flat stucco tile grid with a mono label reads as a texture swatch and shares no material with the wafer deck.
notes.fix: Replace it with a Lubbock County caliche relief carrying a single wafer set at the county seat, lit from the same left key as slide 1.

notes.problem: A brushed-metal label plate filled with type; the 19 dark sockets read as a UI.
notes.fix: Show the cover's boat again, empty with 19 unlit slots, under one work light, and drop the typed plate rows.

notes.problem: The plate ends at a hard seam, the footer sits over the lower rivets, and the nineteen empty pockets read as vent holes at 432 px.
notes.fix: Crop the plate so its bottom rivets clear the footer, give the pockets a lit rim and visible floor, and fade the plate's top edge into the black field.

notes.problem: A type panel: three labelled slots on a bolted plate with a flat value field, and the cite line crosses the plate.
notes.fix: Render the empty 19-slot boat from slide 1 under a single top light with no wafers in it, as the IN SERVICE state.

notes.problem: A top-down orthographic tray that reads as a chart.
notes.fix: Drop the camera to a 30-degree raking angle so the three boats stand as objects with long cast shadows.

notes.problem: A flat graphic band under a seam; the discs are uniform grey buttons.
notes.fix: Tilt the camera about 20 degrees off plan and rake the light low from the left so each disc shows a lit edge and a cast shadow.

notes.problem: Three thin rows of small studs fill only a narrow band of the frame.
notes.fix: Stand the three wafer boats from slides 3, 5 and 1 side by side at shared scale and crop them to fill two thirds of the frame.

notes.problem: Flat copper crystal cutouts on mid grey textured slate below a hard black type band; no wafer scale.
notes.fix: Rebuild it as a 3D close up of one wafer from the frame 1 bench, with a raised epitaxial island grown on its mirror face, raked by a single side light.

notes.problem: The copper-on-slate epitaxy relief is abstract at feed size.
notes.fix: Shoot a single wafer in a reactor susceptor at a low angle, with a copper film visibly half grown across it.

notes.problem: A small die-patterned wafer in a grey haze with no contact shadow.
notes.fix: Push the camera in until the wafer runs off the right and bottom edges, seat it on a dark chuck with a hard contact shadow, and give it one bright rim edge.
